turnaround_reason: Performance-suspension maker (bikes, powersports, Marucci baseball) hammered by pandemic-era bike overstock and channel destocking; now stabilizing with cost cuts and powersports growth.
bullish_points: Beat Q1 and Q2 2026; Q2 adj EBITDA topped guidance by ~$5M and management raised the 2026 sales view
Powersports revenue +22.5%; adj EBITDA margin +250bps sequentially; bike destocking 'taking shape'
New e-bike, softball/Marucci fitments and an autonomous-EV OEM award signal R&D payoff
Reasonable value at forward P/E ~10.6, current ratio 3.1, positive FCF
bearish_points: Revenue still -4.5% y/y; GAAP profit margin -20% (amortization/impairment drag)
Upside to analyst mean target $21 is only ~6% from ~$19.8 — much of the recovery looks priced in
Options are effectively illiquid (call OI 94, put OI 15)
catalyst: Q3 earnings showing continued margin recovery and 2027 demand normalization
suggested_trade: Spot only, starter near $19-20; genuine recovery but partly priced in
key_risk: Consumer-discretionary weakness stalls the bike/powersports recovery before margins fully normalize
would_skip_if: Destocking recovery stalls or sequential margin gains reverse
